```lean
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨b₂, h₂, .refl b₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨b₁, .par ha hb, .refl b₁⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨c₁, hc₁a, hc₁b⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha''
      let ⟨c₂, hc₂a, hc₂b⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb''
      exact ⟨c₁ ⬝ c₂, .par hc₁a hc₂a, .par hc₁b hc₂b⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha]
      exact ⟨b', hb, .red_I b'⟩
    case red_K a₂ b₂ =>
      cases Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha with
      | intro a'' ha'' hc'' =>
        rw [hc''.2]
        exact ⟨a'', ha'', .red_K a'' b'⟩
    case red_S a₂ c₂ =>
      cases Sab_irreducible a₂ c₂ a' ha with
      | intro a'' b'' ha'' hb'' hc'' =>
        rw [hc''.2]
        use a'' ⬝ b'' ⬝ (c₂ ⬝ b')
        constructor
        · exact .par (.par (.par (.refl S) ha'') (.par (.refl (S ⬝ a'')) hb'')) (refl b')
        · exact .red_S a'' c₂ b''
  case red_I a₂ =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₂, .red_I a₂, .refl a₂⟩
    case par c b₁' hc hb =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      exact ⟨b₁', hb, .red_I b₁'⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨a₂, .refl a₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case red_K a₂ b₂ =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₂, .red_K a₂ b₂, .refl a₂⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      cases Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha with
      | intro a'' ha'' hc'' =>
        rw [hc''.2]
        exact ⟨a'', ha'', .red_K a'' c'⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨a₂, .refl a₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case red_S a₂ b₂ c₂ =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₂ ⬝ c₂ ⬝ (b₂ ⬝ c₂), .red_S a₂ b₂ c₂, .refl _⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      cases Sab_irreducible a₂ b₂ d hd with
      | intro a'' b'' ha'' hb'' hc'' =>
        rw [hc''.2]
        exact ⟨a'' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b'' ⬝ c'), .par ha'' hc, .red_S a'' c' b''⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨a₂ ⬝ c₂ ⬝ (b₂ ⬝ c₂), .refl _, .refl _⟩
```
